Technical: moveset source Lucky Chloe lives in technical files only, never in canon.

qcf+1.name: Vitriol Spit
qcf+1.note: WH CANON move. Ryusan spits a glob of her own acid — it burns spirits, not just flesh. Mid projectile; the corrosion lingers on block (chip). 'You don't get to tell me to calm down.'

d/b+3+4.name: Corrosion Claw
d/b+3+4.note: WH CANON move. Low claw rake with acid-tipped fingers. Leaves a sizzling mark on the arena floor for the round.

b+2+3.name: Don't Tell Me To Calm Down
b+2+3.note: WH CANON move. Power-crush shoulder charge — armor through one hit, then the acid burst. Her signature line is the move's name; she says it mid-charge, flat.

SCT,b+3+4.name: Acid Rain Dance
SCT,b+3+4.note: WH CANON move. From her SCT dance stance: a spinning kick that flings acid droplets in an arc. The droplets are the hitbox — ducking under the leg still gets you burned.

hcb+1.name: Jotei's Receipt
hcb+1.note: WH CANON move. Command grab: Ryusan grabs the opponent by the collar and hisses the name of what the Jotei family did. Break with 1. She is living proof of their soul-binding crimes — the throw is the evidence.

d+1+2.name: Meltdown
d+1+2.note: WH CANON super. Ryusan lets the corrosion go all the way — a full-body acid eruption. Costs a full Nine-Soul Meter. The arena floor smokes for the rest of the round.

stances.name: SCT (dance stance)
stances.description: Ryusan's dance-fighter sway, inherited from the Chloe base and re-tuned to her acid-punk rhythm. 7 recorded options: mids, lows, and the Acid Rain Dance exit.

stances.name: Back Turned
stances.description: 18 recorded BT options. She fights facing away like she means it — the trial taught her nobody watches her back, so she stopped needing them to.

stances.name: Full Crouch
stances.description: 7 recorded crouch options. Low to the ground, coiled — the corrosion pools under her feet here.

stances.name: While Standing
stances.description: 6 rising options. She comes up swinging, every time.

stances.name: While Running
stances.description: 5 running options including the running throw. She does not walk toward problems.

stances.name: Sidestep
stances.description: 1 recorded sidestep option. Minimal — she'd rather go through than around.

combos.note: Bread-and-butter string. The third hit is the one that matters.
Hopkick-style launcher into low — mid/low mix that keeps them guessing.
Dance-stance pressure string. Cancel into Acid Rain Dance (SCT,b+3+4) to end rounds.
Mid poke into Corrosion Claw — her canon punish.
'Don't Tell Me To Calm Down' armors through, Meltdown ends it. Full meter required.
